summary: Petition concerning the Aug. 30 Damon women's-prison campaign video remains unresolved on the merits.
notes: Renewed candidate-specific search through Sep. 6 found no final Central Elections Committee merits ruling on the Damon video. Other CEC rulings involving Ben-Gvir campaign videos are distinct and are not transferred. The complaint allegations remain allegations; no illegality or motive is inferred without a final/direct finding.

summary: Central Elections Committee chair dismissed a petition seeking to prohibit free distribution of the children's book 'The Minister Who Didn't Stop.'
notes: Exculpatory/disposition record: multiple reports state that Justice Noam Sohlberg dismissed the petition after receiving Ben-Gvir/Otzma Yehudit responses. This is not accepted as an adverse accountability event. Preserve the dismissal precisely and do not characterize it as a general judicial endorsement of every aspect of the book/distribution beyond the petition's disposition.
